BrightPath: "Delivery lead time: 21 calendar days from purchase order".

Nimbus: In the HTML snippet: "Delivery 7 business days." So 7 business days.

Orbital: In CSV: "lead_time" column: "10 business days".

Thus fastest is Nimbus with 7 business days. Need to output "Fastest delivery: Nimbus Tech Supply". Ensure line exactly as requested. Also maybe mention vendor name. The vendor name is Nimbus Tech Supply. So final answer: "Fastest delivery: Nimbus Tech Supply".
